# Four Dogs Entertainment
Four Dogs Entertainment creates trivia, Music Bingo, interactive game nights, weddings, karaoke, private events, and corporate entertainment in South Carolina.
Official event information: https://4dogsentertainment.com/events/
Services: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/
Booking: https://4dogsentertainment.com/booking/
Recurring schedule: Tuesdays at Top Dawg Tavern in Columbia; Wednesdays and Thursdays at Charter 803 Bar & Grill in Lexington. All begin at 6:30 PM from August 11, 2026.
Four Dogs Survey Showdown is a Four Dogs survey-style competition and is not affiliated with Family Feud. Are You Smarter Than a Barstool? is a parody experience and is not affiliated with Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?
